quests.title: Locked Rooms
quests.summary: Pledges vanish from a locked strongroom at Vance House. The lender wants a plain answer.

offer.say: #greet#, #address#. Pledges gone from a locked room: a ring, a clip, a bracelet. No lock forced, no window open. The Heights say a Quickened wolf walks through walls. I'd rather a plain answer. See the room, ask my servant and the Thornburys' man, and watch my street one night.
offer.thanks: #thanks#. Nobody by the street. Then by what, the open air? There's an old street under these houses, they say, from before the walls. Find where it opens, and find who knows it.

objectives.label: See the strongroom at Vance House.
Ask the Thornburys' man what went from their house.
Watch the Vance street one night.

rewards.detail: watched the Vance street for the wall-walking thief

Put the lender's rates to her plainly.

phases.journal: Pledges vanish from a locked strongroom on the Rise, and the Heights whisper of a wall-walking thief.

effects.text: Lock your doors, they say. Mine were locked. Bright One keep us from wolves who walk through walls.

triggers.note: Each visit: the residents' choices and a fresh shared goal; the rumour walks the Heights.

effect.words: Did you take the pledges?
effect.reply: I've never touched the strongroom key. But I've heard scratching under the cellar floor at night, like something in the drains, and the cellar smells of old stone and wet. Nobody believes a servant.

effect.words: Was your house robbed too?
effect.reply: Not robbed, no. The master bought a brass clip off Vance House last winter, a pledge somebody in the Sump never paid back, and it went from his harness room. Funny sort of thief, that takes back only what was pawned.

effect.words: Somebody knows the old street under the Heights. Is it you?
effect.reply: Might be. Folk who know it don't shout it in the lane. You found the cache, so you know I'm not much of a ghost. Ask me straight what I did, and I'll tell you straight.

effect.words: Do you keep watch for her?
effect.reply: Somebody has to whistle. She's cleverer than the whole Heights lot. If you're going to name her, name me too. It's only fair.

phases.journal: Another pledge gone, and all the Heights talk of Gifts.

effects.text: Another pledge gone, and the whole Heights whispering about Gifts. I want a plain answer, and nobody will give me one.

effect.words: You took the pledges from Vance House.

effect.words: Show me the way you came.
effect.reply: Down the Sunken Street, past the bricked arch, up the drain under the Vance cellar. Mind the low bit. And don't tell the school. They think I'm at lessons.

effect.words: If I carried a Gift, I'd know one. You haven't got one, have you?
effect.reply: No. I've just got four paws and a good nose and an old street nobody remembers. You lot make everything into magic.

effect.words: Your rates are robbery. Let the Sump pledges go.
effect.reply: Robbery? A penny a week on a mark is... a great deal, put that way. Bright One forgive me, I keep a ledger like a fist. Let them go, then. And the girl stays out of my cellar.

effect.words: It was a Quickened wolf. Nobody could have stopped it.
effect.reply: Then the Heights were right, and I was a fool to want a plain answer. I'll write to whoever answers for such wolves. Somebody must.

effect.words: It was a Sump pup, through an old drain. No Gift at all.
effect.reply: A child? Through my cellar? Bright One, and the whole Heights talking of Gifts. Her debt is called in, and the abbey's board can feed her. A plain answer. I asked for it.
